questions.q: What does p95 response time mean?
options: 95% of requests were at or below this time
questions.why: It is a percentile, not an average.

options: Load: expected traffic; stress: beyond capacity to find the breaking point
Load: one user; stress: two users

questions.why: Latency is time per request; throughput is volume per time.

questions.q: In k6, how do you make a run fail automatically when p95 is too slow?
Why record a baseline before changes?
options: So later results can be compared against a known reference
questions.why: Without a baseline you cannot tell if performance regressed.
